description: List every product in one China futures exchange's daily report (SHFE, INE, ZCE or GFEX) for a trading day, ranked by open interest: contract count, total volume, total open interest, main contract and its settlement, and whether the product has any trading activity. Use to discover product codes before cn_futures_daily. Defaults to the latest published trading day.

date.description: Trading day, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD. Omit for the latest published day.

name: cn_futures_products
